steps.name: modules-model-children
steps.subject: ModulesModel: children of an excepted category without mutating the list being iterated
steps.description:
childrenList() removed and appended items of the list it was iterating over, so modules of an
excepted category could be skipped or repeated; data() also rejected valid indexes past rowCount()
of the root. The children are now collected into a new list.

steps.name: android-hardware-settings
steps.subject: Android host: network, Bluetooth and power settings open the Android settings
steps.description:
On the Android host the phone's radios, networks and suspend belong to Android. When the host's
platform socket exists, the Wi-Fi, network, cellular, Bluetooth and power modules hand over to the
project's platform helper, which opens the matching Android settings page; other sessions keep the
desktop modules.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [Android host specific: hands the hardware settings to Android]
